payload.description:
Cheap dispatch smoke test. Do exactly this and nothing more:

1. Run `.venv/bin/spotticus status`.
2. Leave a Kanbus comment on this task with the eligibility line for each pool (one line each, no analysis).
3. Close the task.

Change no files. Do not create a worktree, a branch, or a PR. This chore exists to prove the dispatch loop works, not to produce work.
payload.title: Spot smoke: report pool status
